originalCells.Details:
we have 2 different types of service providers: one is PawSapce full-time employees, who have the 1st preference of orders and they do not need to technically accept the orders since their availability is already accounted for. Next come the contract partners who work like cab aggregator service providers, where we will send the orders to multiple people based on the location criteria and availability, and they are free to accept or reject it.

The order can be assigned to full-time employees or contract partners based on the location criteria. i need you to think of the assignment logic; the primary criteria is location and the 1st session date and time availability. While assigning the orders, you need to also consider the travel time from the previous order, including some buffer. So build a robust order assignment logic.

the important thing for the assignment logic to work is the availability calendar that needs to be updated by both types of service providers at least once a month, including weekly offs for full-time guys and other type offs for contractors. so you need to build this inside the partner app and prominently display it as well. In the calendar, apart from days, we also need to include availability hours since contract partners can take orders from other platforms as well.

rows.remaining: Full-time-first/location/window/travel/calendar guards and contractor atomic award included. Monthly calendar freshness and prominent editable hours/off controls remain partner policy/UI dependencies.
